paper_title: Rechecking Recheck Requests in Continuous Integration: An Empirical Study of OpenStack

selection.note: mineru key is unreliable; blocks are selected by title/body/inheritance. rescued_from_other counts sections labeled other but treated as typed roles.

claims.statement: A statistical model trained on OpenStack recheck requests can discriminate between successful and failed rechecks well, outperforming baseline approaches by 23.6 percentage points in AUROC (0.736).
claims.evidence_quote: our model can differentiate successful and failed rechecks well, outperforming baseline approaches by 23.6 percentage points in terms of AUROC (0.736)

claims.statement: Skipping rechecks predicted to fail would avoid 86.49% of wasted rechecks and save roughly 262 years of compute time.
claims.evidence_quote: Applying our model to skip recheck requests when they are predicted to fail would avoid 86.49% of wasted rechecks, saving roughly 262 years of compute time.
